text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Summer camp started today! I've come to improve my skills, so even though I'm roasting out here, I've gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that if I run cool enough, things will start looking up! I've gotta get stronger for the Queen Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: P.S. Thanks oodles for all your letters. I'm doing great! And those chilled noodles you sent boosted my mood even higher! Nothing can scare me now!
